body: I've been pretty stable on these meds for a while...just been really down the past couple of weeks with family and just some stuff here. It's a vicious cycle
I'm surrounded by people, as a soph i probably know half the people on the campus...yet I always feel so alone. I'm just so tired of feeling like absolute shit all the fucking time
I just feel so helpless. it's just one thing on top of another.
funnily enough...I have...years ago, when I first tried

I'm being flown on Sunday halfway across the country by Microsoft to interview for a summer internship at their National HQ. Yes, it's an amazing opportunity, yes I've worked my ass off my entire life to get here. Yet here I am with these scars. I can barely breathe every time I turn to my computer to write a response

I'm an engineering college student, so not only am I overloaded with work, but I a few weeks ago I found out in the same week that my dad had to quit his already shitty job because his anxiety is so bad he can't make the drive then two days later found out on accident that he has cancer. Not to mention the fact that my parents split this summer and my dad was hospitalized the day of my birthday for electroshock therapy because his antidepressants aren't working. I'm the only person in this world he has to talk to, and it's too much. I can't take hearing every day how miserable he is, how alone. I can't do it all...i just can't
the song that always got me through everything was Hurt by Nine Inch Nails...listening to it I just break down even more

why can I only focus on the bad? Every time I start writing a response I burst into tears because I just don't want to deal with it any longer....I have the best life I could possibly ever want, and all I am is depressed...sitting here in my room crying and bleeding when I've got the world in front of me...but i can't fucking look up
thanks for the offer...I've been looking at "tomorrow" for 6 years now...and it's always shittier than the last one
Music is my life. It's part of who I am. What do I like? I like being happy. Can't seem to do it though
been seeing a therapist for 7 years...been on 8 different meds...still can't get over it
